_about: The Shop (src/delivery/shop.js, render/shop.js; CHECKLIST item 115). PLACEHOLDER ECONOMY: the owner has not decided what buys card packs, so the currency here is a stand-in, named so nobody mistakes it for the game's money (the tips, the bank): it is its own balance in the save (Progress.data.shopCash), never the bank, and a new save has none. Nothing in the game gives it yet: ?shopcash=<n> sets it for a visit (nothing saved), and with ?debug the Shop shows a button that adds some (saved). currency: its name, a short name, a sign. sections: the Shop's rows, top to bottom. offers: id (unique), section, kind (a pack kind of packs.json: standard, ten, career, special), count (packs given), price (in the placeholder currency), was (an old price shown struck through, for a sale; null: none), ribbon ('featured', 'sale', 'new', 'best' or null), name, blurb; from (a special pack's event id, events.json special: the offer shows only while that event is on, its featured cars on the tile; featured: car ids to show instead of the event's own). Buying takes the price and gives the packs (Packs.grant) and opened at once (Packs.revealNow: the reveal, render/packs.js).
